verdict.why: The pipeline at line 121 can trigger SIGPIPE when head exits early, causing an unwanted error message.
The original list comprehension iterates over all sessions, including IDLE ones, as shown on line 148
The later change replaces authSetProc.exitCode with a passed exitCode, confirming the original was incorrect.
The -q flag indeed suppresses output, leading to empty pipeline results, and the later change removes it confirming the defect.
The original code lacked a Keys.priority setting, so the Escape key could be intercepted by other focused items, confirming the reported defect.
The later change replaces the same constant with a new URL, confirming the original ID was outdated.
The later change fixes the bug by replacing Layout.preferred* with implicit* indicating the original code caused the collapse.
The original code uses $CLI_TIMEOUT for item list, which can abort large fetches, and the later change replaces it with a dedicated timeout variable.
Assigning selectedIndex on open is intentional behavior, not a bug.
The code declares approvedOpenCodeToolCalls as a Set<string>, which can only hold command names and not their argument strings.
Number(i.limit) turns null/empty into 0, bypassing the null check and causing incorrect estimates.
The original line concatenates the quoted name directly, causing hyprctl to misinterpret a leading dash as an option flag.
The code copies a predictable temporary file via cp, allowing a race‑condition overwrite.
Default Text element uses AutoText, so modelData.name can be rendered as rich text allowing HTML injection.
The response is still set in the exception block, so no UnboundLocalError occurs
The function only matches "chromium" exactly, so Chrome is missed, confirming the described defect.
Space has code point <0x80, so the original check returns the character instead of mapping it to the required 'space' keysym.
The later change reduces the width value, confirming the original assignment caused an excessive width overflow.
The later change replaces the hardcoded timeout with a variable, confirming the original hardcoded 5 s was insufficient.
The code reads root.manifest.__sourceDir, a private field that is removed, causing the path to be incorrect.
The code uses only root.offset to allow index 1, matching the described bug.
togglefloating is a valid hyprctl dispatcher, so the code does not call a non-existent command
The original running condition lacks a visibility check, causing the animation to run even when hidden.
The code assigns inertTooltipText directly without processing HTML tags.
The height is fixed to Math.ceil(root.height/16) preventing conditional shrinking.
The original model uses Quickshell.screens, iterating all screens, causing the drawer to appear on every monitor.
The original line logs only tokenReply->errorString() without capturing the response body containing OAuth error details.
The signal definition directly conflicts with the auto-generated pageChanged signal for the existing page property
The code only builds a file path string; no command execution occurs, so the risk described is not applicable.
The later change modifies the kill command to target the process group, confirming the original line only killed the wrapper and left children orphaned.
The code uses a hardcoded Style.space(680) for contentHeight, which was later reduced, confirming the original excessive value caused layout issues.
The original line hardcodes a path assuming ~/.config/omarchy, which is a real limitation
The pattern `$REPO*` matches any path with the same prefix, leading to over‑deletion of sibling links.
The code uses self.tracks.first() instead of the active queue, causing playback to start from the library's first track.
The code directly assigns to a read‑only property, which the later change replaces with a safe method call.
The original code calls net.post without setting the required Authorization header, which the later change adds.
The state directory is intentionally used for persistent storage, not a defect.
The y property is set to a constant Style.space(4), fixing the tooltip's vertical position and causing overlap.
The later change replaces service.data with service.payload, confirming the original call was incorrect.
The later change corrects the verticalAlignment from AlignTop to AlignVCenter, confirming the original setting caused the off‑center issue.
